content_json.heading: Authenticity Guarantee: 100% Hand-Painted
content_json.paragraph: All artworks crafted at DotAndArt are authentic, physical hand-painted creations. Every image on this website is an original photograph of actual physical pieces, never AI-generated or digitally fabricated.

content_json.paragraph_5: Today, DotAndArt is not just about selling handmade art. It is about creating meaningful pieces that become part of someone's home, celebrations and memories.
content_json.paragraph_1: What started as a love for colours, patterns and the simple joy of creating with my hands slowly grew into something much more meaningful—my own art journey.
content_json.paragraph_4: Every DotAndArt creation is painted by hand, one dot and one detail at a time. Whether it is a personalised photo mandala, a festive piece, a wall artwork or a custom creation, I put a little piece of my creativity and love into each one.
content_json.paragraph_3: With time, my art has evolved into a blend of traditional mandala patterns, contemporary colours and Indian artistic influences. I enjoy experimenting with colours, textures and different forms while keeping the handmade character of every piece alive.
content_json.statement_heading: Hi, I’m Shital Thosar, the artist and creator behind DotAndArt.
content_json.paragraph_2: I found myself drawn to Dot Mandala Art, where tiny dots come together to create intricate patterns, balance and harmony. For me, mandala is not just about creating something beautiful. It is a process of slowing down, being present and finding a little calm in the middle of everyday life.
content_json.closing_thanks: Thank you for being a part of my creative journey.

faqs.question: What materials and tools are used in creating Dot Mandala and Lippan Artworks?
faqs.answer: Each dot mandala is handcrafted using moisture-resistant engineered MDF wooden boards, high-grade artist heavy-body acrylic paints, fine dotting tools, and authentic reflective mirrors. Lippan art pieces are crafted using traditional mud and ceramic relief clay mixtures combined with intricately arranged hand-cut glass mirrors (aabhla). Every completed artwork is sealed with archival, UV-resistant protective gloss varnish for longevity.

faqs.question: Are the artworks ready to hang upon arrival?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every artwork comes 100% ready to hang with a heavy-duty, rust-resistant triangle or sawtooth hanging hook pre-installed on the back, along with soft wall-stabilizer bumpers to ensure the artwork sits flush and protects your wall surface.

faqs.question: Can I commission a custom design, color palette, or specific size?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Custom orders are warmly welcomed. You can choose specific sizes (from 8 inches up to 36+ inches), color schemes matching your interior palette, sacred geometry patterns, or personalized inscriptions. Reach out via our Bespoke Commissions page or WhatsApp directly with the artist to discuss your ideas.

faqs.question: How long does it take to create and dispatch a handcrafted artwork?
faqs.answer: Depending on the complexity and diameter, standard catalog items ship within 1–3 business days. Bespoke commissioned pieces typically require 5 to 12 days to ensure adequate curing time for clay relief layers, precision dotting in multiple pigment layers, and complete varnish drying.

faqs.question: How are the delicate artworks packed for safe transit?
faqs.answer: We take utmost care in packaging. Each piece is wrapped in acid-free tissue, enclosed in multiple layers of heavy-duty shock-absorbing bubble wrap, protected with rigid corner guards, and encased in reinforced double-wall corrugated cartons or sturdy wooden crating for oversized mirrors.

faqs.question: Do you ship across India and internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide tracked and insured shipping across India (usually arriving within 3–7 business days) as well as worldwide international express delivery with reputed logistics partners (DHL/FedEx).

faqs.question: How should I care for and clean my Dot Art and Lippan mirror wall hangings?
faqs.answer: Maintenance is very simple. Gently dust the surface with a soft, clean, dry microfiber cloth or a soft bristle brush. For Lippan mirrors, you may lightly wipe the mirror glass with a barely damp cotton swab. Never use harsh abrasive chemicals, alcohol sprays, or soak the piece in water. For indoor display away from direct rain and prolonged harsh direct outdoor sunlight.

faqs.question: What is your payment and advance policy for custom commissions?
faqs.answer: For custom commissioned artwork, a 50% advance booking deposit is required to begin design sketching, material sourcing, and studio creation. The remaining 50% balance is payable upon completion after we share high-definition photos and video of your finished artwork prior to secure dispatch.

faqs.question: What happens if an artwork is damaged during courier transit?
faqs.answer: Every shipment is 100% transit-insured. In the extremely rare event that your package arrives damaged, simply take a short unboxing video and clear photographs of the outer packaging and damaged item within 24 hours of receipt, and send it to our WhatsApp helpline (+91 8652162647). We will immediately replace or restore your piece free of charge.

faqs.question: Do Dot And Art creations come with an artist Certificate of Authenticity?
faqs.answer: Yes, all original Dot And Art creations come signed by the artist Shital Thosar and include a studio Certificate of Authenticity specifying the artwork title, year of creation, dimensions, and medium used.
